reference.title: Password Policy Guidelines
reference.shortdesc: Organisational password policies and industry best practices for password security management.

section.title: Organizational Password Policy Frameworks and Resources
section.p: The following frameworks and organizations establish standardized password policies for IT administrators and institutions:

ul.li: CIS Password Policy Guide: Consolidates standardized organizational password policy rules for IT administrators and security managers rather than general end users.

CIS Controls & CIS Benchmarks: Vendor-neutral configuration and authentication baselines developed by the Center for Internet Security community to help institutions enforce strong user authentication.
Multi-State Information Sharing and Analysis Center (MS-ISAC): Provides operational cybersecurity input for public-sector and educational organizations implementing institutional password policies.

section.p: Review the complete administrative guidelines in the CIS Password Policy Guide.
